description: This is a unit test class for the SimpleXStreamSerializer in the org.openmrs.serialization package. It contains tests for serializing and deserializing objects, including handling whitelisting, proxies, and entities, specifically for the SimpleXStreamSerializer implementation.

classes.name: SimpleXStreamSerializerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing serialization and deserialization methods of the SimpleXStreamSerializer.

methods.name: serialize_shouldSerializeObject
methods.description: Tests that a Foo object can be serialized into the correct XML string.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldDeserializeStringToClassInstance
methods.description: Tests that a serialized Foo XML string deserializes correctly into a Foo object with proper attributes.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldNotDeserializeProxies
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to deserialize a proxy object throws a SerializationException.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldIgnoreEntities
methods.description: Checks that entities in XML are not deserialized and throw an exception.

methods.name: serialize_shouldNotSerializeProxies
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to serialize a Java proxy object throws an XStreamException.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldNotDeserializeClassesThatAreNotWhitelisted
methods.description: Verifies that classes not whitelisted for deserialization throw a SerializationException.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldDeserializeWhitelistedPackages
methods.description: Tests deserialization of whitelisted package types like 'org.hibernate.**'.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldDeserializeWhitelistedClassesAndPackages
methods.description: Tests deserialization of specific whitelisted class and package types, such as PropertyPath.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldDeserializeWhitelistedHierarchies
methods.description: Verifies that hierarchical whitelist entries like 'hierarchyOf:...' are accepted for deserialization.
